name: Dark Fantasy Bourbon
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Sugar (32.8%), Refined Palm Oil, Colours [INS 150a, INS 150c, INS 150d, INS 129], Starch, Cocoa Solids (2.3%), Milk Solids, Raising Agents [INS 503(ii), INS 500(ii), INS 450(i)], Artificial Flavouring Substances (Vanilla, Chocolate), Emulsifiers [Mono - and Di-glycerides of Fatty Acids (from Palm Oil), Lecithin (from Soyabean)], Plain Chocolate (0.1%), Iodized Salt and Nature Identical Flavouring Substances (Chocolate). Contains Wheat, Milk, Soy. May contain Nut, Sulphite.
